HX1.question: Welche Kundenkonten haben ihren Monatsumsatz vom ersten zum letzten aktiven Monat am staerksten gesteigert (mindestens 5 Bestellungen insgesamt)?
HX1.final_response_text: Es wurden keine Kunden gefunden, die die Kriterien erfüllen, mindestens fünf aktive Monate zu haben und ihren Umsatz vom ersten zum letzten Monat signifikant gesteigert zu haben. Möglicherweise gibt es keine Kunden, die diese spezifischen Bedingungen in der aktuellen Datenbank erfüllen. Wenn du andere Kriterien oder einen anderen Zeitraum in Betracht ziehen möchtest, lass es mich wissen!
HX1.sql_query:
WITH MonthlyRevenue AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS month,
        SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM 
        public.orders o
    JOIN 
        public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
    GROUP BY 
        o.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)
),
CustomerGrowth AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT month) AS active_months,
        FIRST_VALUE(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS first_month_revenue,
        LAST_VALUE(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_month_revenue
    FROM 
        MonthlyRevenue
    GROUP BY 
        customer_id, month, revenue
)
SELECT 
    cg.customer_id, 
    cu.company_name,
    cg.first_month_revenue, 
    cg.last_month_revenue, 
    (cg.last_month_revenue - cg.first_month_revenue) AS revenue_growth
FROM 
    CustomerGrowth cg
JOIN 
    public.customers cu ON cg.customer_id = cu.customer_id
WHERE 
    cg.active_months >= 5
ORDER BY 
    revenue_growth DESC
LIMIT 5;

HX2.sql_query:
WITH RegionUmsatz AS (
    SELECT o.ship_region AS region, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS umsatz, COUNT(o.order_id) AS auftragszahl
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
    GROUP BY o.ship_region
),
MedianAuftragszahl AS (
    SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY auftragszahl) AS median_auftragszahl

FROM RegionUmsatz r
JOIN MedianAuftragszahl m ON r.auftragszahl < m.median_auftragszahl
ORDER BY r.umsatz DESC;

WITH SupplierRevenue AS (
    SELECT 
        p.category_id, 
        p.supplier_id, 
        SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS supplier_revenue

    JOIN public.products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id

Diese Paare zeigen eine hohe Assoziation im Kaufverhalten, was auf eine starke Verbindung zwischen den Produkten hinweist.
HX7.sql_query:
WITH ProductPairs AS (
    SELECT 
        p1.product_id AS product_id_1, 
        p2.product_id AS product_id_2,
        c1.category_id AS category_id_1,
        c2.category_id AS category_id_2,
        COUNT(*) AS pair_count
    FROM public.order_details od1
    JOIN public.order_details od2 ON od1.order_id = od2.order_id AND od1.product_id < od2.product_id
    JOIN public.products p1 ON od1.product_id = p1.product_id
    JOIN public.products p2 ON od2.product_id = p2.product_id
    JOIN public.categories c1 ON p1.category_id = c1.category_id
    JOIN public.categories c2 ON p2.category_id = c2.category_id
    WHERE c1.category_id <> c2.category_id
    GROUP BY p1.product_id, p2.product_id, c1.category_id, c2.category_id
),
ProductCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id, 
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM public.order_details od
    JOIN public.products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id
),
CategoryCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_id, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT od.order_id) AS category_order_count
    FROM public.order_details od
    JOIN public.products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN public.categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
    GROUP BY c.category_id
)
SELECT 
    pp.product_id_1, 
    pp.product_id_2, 
    pp.pair_count, 
    pc1.product_count AS product_count_1, 
    pc2.product_count AS product_count_2,
    cc1.category_order_count AS category_order_count_1,
    cc2.category_order_count AS category_order_count_2,
    (pp.pair_count * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM public.order_details)) / (pc1.product_count * pc2.product_count) AS lift
FROM ProductPairs pp
JOIN ProductCounts pc1 ON pp.product_id_1 = pc1.product_id
JOIN ProductCounts pc2 ON pp.product_id_2 = pc2.product_id
JOIN CategoryCounts cc1 ON pp.category_id_1 = cc1.category_id
JOIN CategoryCounts cc2 ON pp.category_id_2 = cc2.category_id
ORDER BY lift DESC
LIMIT 10;

HX13.question: Welche Mitarbeitenden dominieren einzelne Regionen stark (Anteil groesser als 50 Prozent des Regionalumsatzes)?

HX13.sql_query:
WITH regional_sales AS (
    SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, r.region_description, SUM(o.freight) AS employee_sales,
           SUM(SUM(o.freight)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_description) AS total_regional_sales
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.employees e ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id
    JOIN public.region r ON o.ship_region = r.region_description
    GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, r.region_description
)
SELECT employee_id, first_name, last_name, region_description, employee_sales, total_regional_sales,
       employee_sales * 100.0 / total_regional_sales AS percentage_of_regional_sales
FROM regional_sales
WHERE employee_sales * 100.0 / total_regional_sales > 50
